finding: The prevalence of perinatal asphyxia in general hospitals of Tigray remains high, with low birth weight, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, cesarean section, and prolonged maternal labor being associated factors.
mod_finding: Neonates born with cesarean section are seven times more likely to have perinatal asphyxia than those who are born spontaneously through the vagina.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (less than 2.5 kg) identified as a risk factor for perinatal asphyxia
